The square has side length \(500\) m, so its area is

\[
500^2 = 250{,}000 \text{ m}^2
\]

The circle is inscribed in the square, so its diameter is \(500\) m, meaning its radius is

\[
r = 250 \text{ m}
\]

The area of the circular watered field is

\[
\pi r^2 = \pi(250)^2 = 62{,}500\pi \approx 196{,}350 \text{ m}^2
\]

The area not watered is

\[
250{,}000 - 196{,}350 \approx 53{,}650 \text{ m}^2
\]

Rounded to the nearest thousand square meters:

\[
53{,}650 \approx 54{,}000
\]

The answer is 54,000 square meters.
